evidence: Matches the 'TX fees and policy' label and directly modifies policy fee rate calculation in src/policy/feerate.{cpp,h}.
rationale: Prevents a node crash caused by division by zero when CFeeRate::GetFeePerK() or operator+= is invoked on a zero-sized fee rate. While it resolves an unhandled arithmetic fault, there is no evidence of an external remote denial-of-service vector elevating it to category-critical.
